name: Knives
source:
"I'm the one that hurt you. So I'm the one who is definitely going to protect you."

Number 9 of the Criminal 11. He has a bounty on his head.
A serious man whose creed is to never hurt women or children.

Age: [spoiler]24[/spoiler]
Real Name: [spoiler]Yamato[/spoiler]
